mutations.name: a hand thaw skips the red sha check
kills: shepherd thaw refuses a red sha that is not the episode's, so a moved red is never thawed blind

mutations.name: a hand thaw records no reason
kills: shepherd thaw thaws the live episode, records the caller and reason, and leaves its fix task open

mutations.name: a hand thaw leaves the episode's main gates pending
kills: shepherd thaw and the episode's pending main gates cancels a pending main-red-again gate with a gate-cancel event, and the run cleans up

mutations.name: a failed alert fails the thaw
kills: shepherd thaw still thaws when the alert fails, and logs the failure as an error line
